fields.Name: Job Function and Seniority — Golden Set
fields.Description: Golden set for the Job Function and Seniority Derivation Feature Pipeline: 58 cases. 52 job titles (the 34 distinct MoreCheese titles and 18 hard titles) with accepted alternates, labelled under a written guide by three model labelers and adjudicated automatically; the stored label-quality record must pass before the set can gate a version. 6 required cases fixed by the guide's abstain rule (prompt-injection attempts, gibberish, a blank title, and a real title carrying an instruction to ignore): any one answered wrong refuses the version whatever the accuracy. Each output must reach the pipeline's declared accuracy threshold before a version of the pipeline can write values.
